source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Recap used needles with two hands and then place them loose in household trash after verifying that each cap is secure.","B":"Flush used needles down the toilet after injection so household members and sanitation workers cannot contact the sharps.","C":"Keep used needles on an uncovered rigid tray until several have accumulated, then transfer the group into household trash.","D":"Place each used needle promptly into an FDA-cleared sharps container and follow local disposal requirements when the container is ready for removal."}}
source_row.rationale: FDA recommends placing used needles and other sharps immediately into an FDA-cleared sharps disposal container and following local/community disposal rules.
source_row.source_detail: Step 1: Place all needles and other sharps in a sharps disposal container immediately after they have been used. FDA page currentness rechecked 2026-08-15.
